body:
Target Canonical Cross Host

Declares a canonical URL on a different registrable domain.

Synthetic S6-1 target fixture. Not a copy of any real page.
contract_intent: Syntactically valid cross-host rel=canonical whose target is a DIFFERENT REGISTRABLE DOMAIN under the committed urlkey.registrable_host, with no applicable domain_migrations or trust rule: alias conflict, no alias, identity unmoved. Same-registrable-domain is decided by that committed helper and never by hostname equality, so the target had to differ in its registrable domain and not merely in its hostname. other-target.test is deliberately given no fixture and no robots fixture — a canonical on a different registrable domain is refused on domain policy before any robots check or fetch, so this correction neither fetches nor probes it.
